hypothesis: Structural entity equality, not more memorized sinusoidal identities, may explain previous out-of-vocabulary failure. Quantify benefit of CODED equality scaffolding while learning identical-size three-parameter transition scoring models. The result cannot qualify as learned variable binding.
setup: Three mechanisms: (1) coded exact edge-endpoint equality plus learned three-scalar transition gate, (2) learned sinusoidal identity similarity gate without exact equality and (3) hybrid. All store 12 packed uint16 source/target pairs plus 132 nonself float32 transition scores in a native 16x3x3 Yggdrasil StatePool (576 bytes). Four-edge probabilistic relationship traversal is programmed and identical. Future questions appear only after state formed; future-question BCE trains dev gates.
